messages:
Zoe: Quick packing question for the dinner night at the offsite  suit jacket vs blazer vs wrinkle-resistant dress? I don’t want to check a bag.
Ben: I travel carry-on only too. I roll blazers in a garment folder and it works fine (also those packing cubes with a hanger sleeve).
Hana: If you’re wearing a button-up, pack it folded with tissue paper between layers. Helps a lot with creases.
Marco: Pro tip: wear the bulkiest pieces on the plane (jacket + shoes) to save bag space and reduce wrinkling from being stuffed.
Zoe: Anyone used a hotel steam service for last-minute fixes? Worth the cost?
Ben: Hotel steamers are great but time-consuming. If you have a travel steamer it’s faster. Otherwise drop at the hotel drycleaning if you have 2-3 hours.
Hana: I have a tiny handheld steamer and it saved my life at the last awards dinner. Packs flat.
Marco: Also check the conference dress code  last offsite said "business casual" and people were in dark jeans + blazer. Figure out whether you actually need a suit.
Zoe: Good call. The invite said "smart casual" so probably overkill to pack a full suit. Leaning blazer + wrinkle-free shirt.
Ben: For shoes: bring one dress pair that can double as nicer-casual. Leather sneakers are underrated for this.
Hana: Poll: Pack suit / pack blazer & shirt / wear on plane / buy/borrow locally  react with emoji
Ben: ":necktie:" for pack suit
Hana: ":tshirt:" for blazer & shirt
Marco: ":airplane:" for wear on plane
Zoe: ":shopping:" for buy/borrow locally
travel-bot: Reminder: Expense policy allows dry-cleaning up to $40 for conference attire if pre-approved. Check #finance for how to submit. :robot_face:
Ben: Quick hack: hang a damp towel in the bathroom and run the hot shower for 5-10 mins  steam helps relax wrinkles in a pinch.
Hana: True. Also roll the jacket tightly and then release at the hotel, hang on a hanger inside out for a bit.
Zoe: Anyone have a garment folder they recommend? Looking for something compact.
Marco: I use the Eagle Creek Pack-It Garment Folder. Small, light, and velcro keeps it compact.
Ben: Meme: "me packing like i’m moving out of the country vs me at the offsite: one extra t-shirt" (image)
Hana: Thanks everyone. I’ll do blazer + travel steamer in carry-on and wear sneakers. See you at the meetup!
Zoe: @here last reminder  conference dinner is semi-formal so bring one slightly dressy option. Also drop a DM if you want to borrow a tie or scarf.
Marco: Safe travels  and good luck with wrinkle combat.
